newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes weaker after flat, quiet day.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes weaker after flat, quiet day.

text.p: IPE MAY gas oil closed lower on Thursday having spent a very flat day amid poor volume.
May IPE gas oil closed 75 cents weaker at $171 a tonne.
"It has been very quiet, there is really nothing happening," said one IPE broker.
June Brent was trading one cent down at $18.51 a barrel, having spent much of the day in a narrow ten cent range. The contract's intra-day high was $18.55 and its low $18.36.
Gas oil looked supported at $169.50 and then $166.
"If it can hold at $169.50 it will have room to go higher, maybe to $175 and $177," said a trader.
Some brokers felt gas oil was waiting for a sell-off after several days of gains.
